better_answer_example: As an IT undergraduate with a passion for AI engineering, I had the opportunity to work on a customer support chatbot project. My role involved designing the intent and flow of the chatbot, as well as testing its responses. One of the significant challenges we faced was handling similar questions and providing accurate responses. Through this project, I not only gained hands-on experience with Python and NLP but also developed my problem-solving skills and understanding of team collaboration. I believe this experience has prepared me well for an AI Engineer role, where I can apply my skills and knowledge to develop innovative solutions.
